objective: Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.

description: The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door.  They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.
I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick.  And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.
Please escort me!  And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...
progress: Please be brief.  There is much danger about and we cannot stand idle in conversation.
completion: Thank you for the aid, <name>. I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine. With your help, I see that he has not.
